snippet.title: As We Descend: Update 2 - Engines of Destruction
snippet.description:
As We Descend is available on Steam right now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1769830/As_We_Descend/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=second_update_ea&utm_medium=video

Sign up for more news here: http://AsWeDescend.com

Full patch notes available here on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1769830/view/519719478077948000

As We Descend is a roguelike deckbuilder with the soul of a strategy game. Seek salvation for the last City of humankind with your daring descent to the core of the planet.

Leave your question and thoughts below!
